description:
Modify the visitor badge template to include a barcode. 

1. Open the Badge Designer in Jolly Lobby Track.
2. Select the standard Visitor badge template.
3. Add a Barcode element to the badge layout.
4. Configure the barcode to encode the 'Visitor ID' field (dynamic data), NOT static text.
5. Position the barcode at the bottom of the badge.
6. Save the updated badge template.
